_readme: Every Pinterest pin for Here Supply Co. Run `python3 scripts/build-pins.py` to render images into public/pins. Pins appear in the board's RSS feed (lib/feed.ts) once their publish time passes, and Pinterest picks them up from there within a day. Styles: statement (ink, cream, teal), photo (real photos of Chris and Rhea only, from public/assets/real), printable (the Sunday Board guide). Wrap the accent words of a headline in *asterisks*. Never use stock or AI photos of people here.

pins.head: We sit down every Sunday. *Here is the page we use.*
pins.title: Our 15 Minute Sunday Marriage Meeting (Free Printable)
pins.description: Chris and Rhea sit down for fifteen minutes every Sunday with one sheet of paper and the phones in another room. Watch how it goes and print the same free guide. Weekly couples check in, marriage meeting, family planning.

pins.head: A weekly couples check in *that gets used.*
pins.sub: Four parts, fifteen minutes, one copy between you.
pins.title: Free Weekly Couples Check In Printable
pins.description: A free one page guide for a fifteen minute weekly couples meeting: how you are both doing, the week ahead, home and money, and one thing to protect. Made by a real couple who uses it every Sunday.

pins.head: Start every Sunday with *how are we doing, honestly?*
pins.sub: Then the week, then one thing to protect. Fifteen minutes.
pins.title: A Marriage Meeting Agenda You Can Finish in 15 Minutes
pins.description: A simple weekly marriage meeting agenda: one thing you appreciated, how you are doing, the week on the table, and one thing to protect. No boardroom and no argument. Free printable included.

pins.head: Four small changes for three days, and *your evenings come back.*
pins.title: How to Stop Checking Your Phone at Home
pins.description: Four small changes for three days: grayscale, fewer feeds, silence the noise, and give the phone a home. A practical way for couples and parents to get their evenings back without quitting the phone.

pins.head: One page between you, *fifteen minutes on Sunday.*
pins.title: The Sunday Board Meeting: A 15 Minute Weekly Plan for Couples
pins.description: Get the week out of two heads and onto one page. Meals, money, the calendar, kids, and how you are actually doing. A free printable weekly planning meeting for couples.

pins.head: Two minutes in the driveway *before you walk in.*
pins.sub: Engine off. Name what followed you home. Then go in.
pins.title: The Two Minute Pause Before You Walk In the Door
pins.description: How to leave work at work: park, engine off, name what followed you home, take three slow breaths, then go in. A small transition that changes the first ten seconds at home.

pins.head: Where are the two of you *drifting?*
pins.sub: Five questions and one thing to try tonight. Free, no signup.
pins.title: Where Are You Two Drifting? Free One Minute Couples Quiz
pins.description: Five quick questions about phones, work, short tempers, and time together. Get a plain answer about where your attention is slipping and one thing to try tonight.

pins.head: Fifteen minutes on the floor, *phone in another room.*
pins.sub: Let them lead. Follow their game. End cleanly.
pins.title: How to Be More Present With Your Kids After Work
pins.description: Fifteen minutes on the floor with the phone in another room. Let them lead and follow their game. A simple daily habit for busy parents who want to be more present after work.

pins.head: Get the week out of two heads and *onto one page.*
pins.sub: Meals, money, the calendar, and how you are doing.
pins.title: Weekly Family Planning Printable for Couples
pins.description: One free printable page for the week: meals, money, the calendar, who owns what, and how you are both doing. Fifteen minutes on Sunday keeps the whole week calmer.

pins.head: Everyone needs a third place. *Both of you.*
pins.sub: Somewhere besides home and work where people know your face.
pins.title: Everyone Needs a Third Place, Including Both of You
pins.description: Somewhere besides home and work where people know your face. Why it matters for both partners, and how to find one without turning it into another project.

pins.head: One thing I appreciated about you *this week.*
pins.title: The First Question in Our Weekly Couples Meeting
pins.description: Every Sunday meeting starts with one thing you appreciated about each other this week. It changes the whole conversation. The free weekly guide walks you through the rest.

pins.head: Put the phone away *before the car moves.*
pins.sub: Set the route, choose who can reach you, then drive.
pins.title: Put the Phone Away Before the Car Moves
pins.description: A simple setup for navigation, important contacts, and driving with your eyes up. A small habit that keeps everyone in the car safer.

pins.head: Everyone was looking down when I went back to *Clemson.*
pins.sub: Three small ways to make looking up the default again.
pins.title: What Felt Different When I Went Back to Clemson
pins.description: A short story about phones, missed moments of connection, and three small ways to make looking up the default again at home, in the car, and around people.
